_provenance: schema-derived from DE-AUTOTUNE-OOM feature plan (AC-2/AC-5/AC-7) — autotune path must thread bounded n_jobs=1 to generate_synthetic_history regardless of ALPHABOT_MAX_JOBS env var; empirical AC-1 verdict in feature-plans/autotune-oom-memory-bound.md establishes n_jobs=1 as the safe bound on the 2-core/3GB-cgroup droplet

_site._anchor_provenance: captured from fix/autotune-oom-memory-bound HEAD 0cad13d; behavioral tests locate the call via spy on autotuner.synthetic_history.generate_synthetic_history so refactors do not silently invalidate the test

replay_parallelism_contract._global_default_comment: _resolve_replay_n_jobs() returns -1 when ALPHABOT_MAX_JOBS is unset — joblib forks all cores, OOM on the 2-core / 3GB-cgroup droplet (root cause confirmed in AC-1)
replay_parallelism_contract._autotune_safe_comment: n_jobs=1 → joblib sequential backend (no fork) → peak 2.03GB under the 3.0GB cgroup MemoryMax cap (AC-1 empirical cgroup-bounded profile, 2026-06-29). n_jobs=2 on a 2-core box is equivalent to n_jobs=-1 — both fork 2 workers, same OOM.

generate_synthetic_history_api_contract._rationale: Threads 1:1 to Parallel(n_jobs=...); autotuner passes n_jobs=1 explicitly so the autotune path is bounded regardless of ALPHABOT_MAX_JOBS, while other callers' None/default continues to resolve via _resolve_replay_n_jobs(). Name chosen to match the Parallel kwarg exactly — no impedance mismatch.

autotune_module_contract._rationale: Per project rule: no magic numbers in autotuner.py — every constant named + source comment. Pattern requirement ensures the name is semantically auditable (avoids false-positive match on an unrelated int constant whose value happens to be 1).

mem_cap_guard._rationale: tests._mem_cap.DEFAULT_CAP_GB must not be raised above 24 GB (the operator-approved ceiling for the dev host with 67.8GB RAM). Raising it risks uncapped fan-out and Kernel-Power 41 hard-reboots (2026-06-21 RCA).
